findings.finding: The bounded Assembly-unit Discovery observed selective prediction loss after suppressing the three selected Assembly members, but its prospectively fixed comparator had zero baseline spikes per unit while each target member had one. The fresh exact seven-component matched-load feasibility successor then exhaustively failed to find an exact nonmember comparator on fixed DEV seeds 501 and 502 without executing an intervention.
findings.impact: The current matched-load object is terminal and must not be repaired outcome-responsively.

findings.finding: Fakhar et al. 2024 show that neural activity and causal functional contribution can dissociate after downstream nonlinear/recurrent transformations; observational activity similarity is not causal-equivalence.
sources: Fakhar et al., Scientific Reports 14 (2024), DOI 10.1038/s41598-024-52423-7

findings.finding: Engram-allocation experiments use selected-ensemble versus similar-number random-neuron silencing as an ordinary causal-necessity control, while separate work shows that even sparse nonselective perturbation can disrupt memory.
sources: Contextual fear memory retrieval is vulnerable to hippocampal noise, Cerebral Cortex 31 (2021), DOI 10.1093/cercor/bhaa257

findings.finding: Focal perturbations can cause distributed network reconfiguration, so local degree/two-hop structural matching is a proxy rather than a guarantee of matched perturbation footprint.

Multi-neuron interventions identify coalition/set-level effects but complicate attribution of individual causal contribution; individual-responsibility claims require additional causal-attribution structure.
sources: Lepperød et al., PLOS Computational Biology 19 (2023), DOI 10.1371/journal.pcbi.1011574
Fakhar et al., Scientific Reports 14 (2024), DOI 10.1038/s41598-024-52423-7

findings.finding: A future independently motivated Assembly-causality successor should not treat exact observational-signature equality as the only valid route. A prospectively fixed random/stratified lesion distribution with equal information privilege, plus explicit downstream perturbation-footprint measurement, is a stronger ordinary control ladder. This inference does not reopen the current terminal object.
